variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.description: Master database password — auto-generated. Referenced by all Supabase services via ${{postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
variables.description: Default database name. All Supabase schemas live inside this database.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PORT
variables.description: PostgreSQL listen port. Keep 5432 — all consumer services reference this port.

variables.name: PGDATA
variables.description: PostgreSQL data directory under the persistent volume mount. Do not change after first boot.
